newsitem.title: USA: Los Angeles Cty supervisors okay massive jail.
newsitem.headline: Los Angeles Cty supervisors okay massive jail.

text.p: Los Angeles County's supervisors have voted to open a $373 million state-of-the-art jail facility after years of planning and debate, county officials said on Friday.
The Board of Supervisors voted unanimously to open the 4,100-bed, Twin Towers jail facility as early as January.
But county officials on Friday said the financial viability of the plan would depend on revenues raised from the operation of other jail facilities under contract to other jurisdictions.
Earlier this week, county Chief Administrative Officer David Janssen endorsed the plan, saying it would ease jail overcrowding and appeared financially sound.
